create_word_reverse_mutator: create a WordReverseMutator instance with an Opt config to reverse words in dialogue messages
use_message_mutation_method: use the message_mutation method to reverse word order in a ParlAI message text field
register_word_reverse_mutator: register the word_reverse mutator with ParlAI to apply word reversal mutations to dialogue data
combine_with_flatten_mutator: combine the word_reverse mutator with the flatten mutator to reverse both labels and texts
reverse_multiline_text: reverse words in each newline-separated utterance independently using the WordReverseMutator class
